To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the volatility of the aggregate marginal product of capital is positively related to the volatility of output and (b) the price of aggregate physical capital is directly related to the volatility.
the value of aggregate capital and the value of equity claims on capital are directly related to the volatility of the economy, while the value of debt claims on capital are not.
the price of capital is directly related to the marginal product of risk and the price of levered claims is inversely related to marginal product of risk.
In summary, our research is concerned with

understanding the role of uncertainty in the determination of asset prices in a dynamic economy with production, and in particular with understanding the relation between the volatility in the marginal product of aggregate capital and the price and riskiness of claims on aggregate capital.
the effects of uncertainty on the value of capital.
